story: Wang Mang came from the family of the Grand Empress Dowager Wang Zhengjun. Famous for his frugal life and Confucian learning, he became regent for the boy Emperor Ping and then 'acting emperor' for the infant Ruzi Ying. Supporters flooded the court with omens, including a bronze casket said to show that Heaven wanted him to rule.
In 9 CE Wang Mang took the throne and named his dynasty Xin, meaning 'new'. When he asked for the imperial seal, his aunt the Grand Empress Dowager threw it on the ground in anger, chipping a corner.

Wang Mang wanted to bring back the perfect age described in the classics. He declared all farmland to be 'king's fields' that could not be bought or sold, and ordered families with too much land to give it to relatives and neighbours. He banned the buying and selling of slaves, set up state monopolies and price controls, and renamed offices and places across the empire.
story_zh: 王莽出自太皇太后王政君的家族，以生活俭朴、精通儒学著称。他先辅佐年幼的汉平帝，后来又以“摄皇帝”的身份代行幼主孺子婴的皇权。拥护者纷纷向朝廷献上各种祥瑞，其中有一只铜匮，据说显示上天要王莽做皇帝。
公元9年，王莽即皇帝位，改国号为“新”。他向姑母太皇太后索要传国玉玺时，太皇太后愤怒地把玉玺摔在地上，摔崩了一角。
王莽一心想恢复儒家经典中描绘的理想盛世。他宣布天下田地都是“王田”，不得买卖，田产过多的人家必须分给亲族邻里；他禁止买卖奴婢，推行国家专卖和平抑物价的措施，还把全国许多官名、地名都改了。
wang-mang.why: Wang Mang's seizure of the throne broke the Han line for fifteen years, and his reforms became a famous example of good intentions turning into disaster.
wang-mang.why_zh: 王莽篡位使汉朝中断了十五年，他的改革也成为好心办坏事的著名例子。

story: By 17 CE famine had struck the Jing region in the middle Yangtze. Hungry people went into the marshes to dig for wild roots and fought each other over them. Two local men, Wang Kuang and Wang Feng, settled their quarrels and became their leaders.

The band made its base in the Lülin, or Green Forest, mountains in what is now Hubei. It grew to tens of thousands and defeated the government troops sent against it. In 22 CE an epidemic killed many of them, and the survivors split into two groups, the Xinshi army and the Xiajiang army, which moved north and east.
Soon they joined forces with the Pinglin rebels and with Liu Yan and Liu Xiu's men from Nanyang. Together they formed the core of the army that put the Gengshi Emperor on the throne.
story_zh: 到公元17年，荆州一带（今长江中游）发生饥荒。饥民们涌进沼泽挖野荸荠充饥，常常为此争斗。当地人王匡、王凤出面调解纠纷，被推为首领。
这支队伍以绿林山（今湖北境内）为根据地，发展到几万人，多次打败前来镇压的官军。公元22年，一场瘟疫夺去了许多人的生命，幸存者分成新市兵和下江兵两支，分别向北、向东转移。
不久，他们与平林兵以及从南阳起兵的刘縯、刘秀兄弟会合，共同组成了后来拥立更始帝的起义军主力。
lulin.why: The Lülin movement helped bring down the Xin and gave Chinese a lasting term, 'heroes of the green forest', for outlaws.
lulin.why_zh: 绿林起义推动了新朝的覆灭，“绿林好汉”也从此成为对聚众山林、反抗官府者的称呼。

story: In 23 CE, alarmed by the rebels in the south, Wang Mang sent a huge army under Wang Yi and Wang Xun. It was said to number 420,000 men, and it even brought tigers, rhinoceroses and elephants to frighten the enemy. In early summer it surrounded the small town of Kunyang, held by fewer than ten thousand rebels.

While the town held out, Liu Xiu slipped out at night with thirteen horsemen to gather help. He came back with a few thousand men and led the attack himself. His small force killed Wang Xun in battle. The defenders of Kunyang then burst out of the gates.

A violent storm broke, with wind and heavy rain, and the river overflowed. The Xin army panicked and collapsed. Thousands drowned trying to flee. The defeat left Wang Mang with no field army, and Chang'an fell to the rebels a few months later.
story_zh: 公元23年，王莽对南方起义军大为惊恐，派王邑、王寻率大军南下。据说这支军队号称四十二万人，甚至带上了老虎、犀牛和大象来威吓敌人。初夏，大军包围了小城昆阳，城中起义军不到一万人。
在城中坚守之际，刘秀带着十三名骑兵趁夜突围，四处搬兵。他带回几千人马，亲自率军冲锋，以少胜多，在阵前斩杀王寻。昆阳守军也随即开城杀出。
这时狂风暴雨骤起，河水暴涨，新军惊慌失措，全线崩溃，数以千计的人在逃跑中淹死。这场惨败使王莽再无可用的野战军，几个月后长安便被起义军攻破。
kunyang.why: Kunyang destroyed the Xin dynasty's army and made Liu Xiu famous, starting his path to restoring the Han.
kunyang.why_zh: 昆阳之战摧毁了新朝的主力，也使刘秀声名大振，由此走上了复兴汉朝的道路。

people.name: Liu Xiu
people.role_zh: 起义军将领，后为汉光武帝

story: Wang Mang changed the money four times. Even as regent, in 7 CE, he had issued large knife-shaped coins worth far more than their metal. After taking the throne he abolished the wuzhu coin, partly because the character for the Han ruling family's name, Liu, contained the parts 'metal' and 'knife'.

In 10 CE he went further. The new 'treasure goods' system had five materials, gold, silver, tortoise shell, cowrie shell and bronze, and 28 different units of money. Few people understood the values, and ordinary people kept using the old wuzhu coins in secret.

Wang Mang punished those who used or minted illegal coins harshly, sending large numbers of people to forced labour. Markets stopped working and many people were ruined. In 14 CE he replaced the system yet again.
story_zh: 王莽一共改了四次币制。早在公元7年他做辅政大臣时，就发行过面值远高于实际含铜量的大型刀币。称帝后，他废除了五铢钱，原因之一是汉朝皇室的姓“劉”字里含有“金”和“刀”。
公元10年，他推出更复杂的“宝货制”：用金、银、龟甲、贝壳、铜五种材料，铸造出二十八种不同面值的货币。没有几个人搞得清它们的比价，老百姓仍然偷偷使用旧的五铢钱。
王莽对私用、私铸钱币的人施以重罚，大批人被罚作苦役。市场陷入停滞，许多人倾家荡产。公元14年，他又一次推翻重来。
xin-coinage.why: The currency chaos ruined trade and turned many people against Wang Mang.
xin-coinage.why_zh: 币制混乱使商业凋敝，也让许多人转而反对王莽。

story: The Yellow River carries huge amounts of silt, which raises its bed above the surrounding plain. Its dikes need constant repair, and in the late Western Han they had broken several times.

In 11 CE the river burst through near Wei commandery, around modern Puyang. Instead of returning to its old bed, it cut a new course to the sea further south and east through what is now Shandong. The Book of Han says Wang Mang decided not to close the breach, because the new course protected his family's ancestral tombs at Yuancheng from flooding.

For about sixty years the river wandered across the plain, drowning farmland and villages. Hundreds of thousands of people became refugees in the regions of Shandong and northern Jiangsu. It was finally brought under control by the engineer Wang Jing in 69 to 70 CE, under the Eastern Han.
story_zh: 黄河挟带大量泥沙，河床不断抬高，高出两岸平原。河堤需要经常修补，西汉后期就曾多次决口。
公元11年，黄河在魏郡（今河南濮阳一带）决口。河水没有回到旧河道，而是向东南冲出一条新路，经今山东境内入海。《汉书》记载，王莽之所以不堵决口，是因为新河道可以使他家族在元城的祖坟免受水患。
此后约六十年，黄河在平原上四处泛滥，淹没农田村庄，数以十万计的人沦为流民，聚集在今山东和苏北一带。直到东汉永平十二年至十三年（69至70年），水利专家王景才把黄河治理好。
yellow-river-11.why: The floods created masses of starving refugees, who became the Red Eyebrows and other rebels that toppled the Xin.
yellow-river-11.why_zh: 洪灾造成大批饥民流离失所，他们后来组成赤眉等起义军，推翻了新朝。

story: Wang Mang's land law of 9 CE declared all farmland to be 'king's fields'. It could not be bought or sold, and any family with fewer than eight males but more than one jing of land had to give the extra to relatives and neighbours. The sale of slaves was also banned.

The law was hard to enforce and angered both rich and poor. Landowners resisted, officials took bribes, and people who broke the rules by selling land or slaves were punished in great numbers, from nobles down to commoners.
In 12 CE a minister warned that the law was causing unrest. Wang Mang issued an edict allowing king's fields and slaves to be bought and sold again, without penalty under the law.
story_zh: 王莽在公元9年颁布的土地法令规定，天下田地都是“王田”，不得买卖；一家男丁不满八人而田地超过一井的，要把多余的田地分给亲族邻里。买卖奴婢也被禁止。
这项法令很难执行，富人和穷人都不满意。地主们抵制，官吏借机受贿，因私自买卖田地、奴婢而获罪的人，从公卿到平民数不胜数。
公元12年，有大臣进言说法令引起了天下骚动。王莽于是下诏，允许王田和奴婢重新自由买卖，不再依法追究。
wangtian-repealed.why: The repeal showed that Wang Mang's grand plans could not work in practice and undermined trust in his rule.
wangtian-repealed.why_zh: 王田制的废止表明王莽的宏大构想在现实中行不通，也动摇了人们对他统治的信心。

story: In 18 CE, as floods and famine spread in the east, a man named Fan Chong led about a hundred people in revolt at Ju county in Langya, in what is now Shandong. Within a year his followers numbered over ten thousand, and other bands joined them.

The rebels had few written rules: whoever killed someone would die, and whoever injured someone would pay compensation. Their leaders used simple titles taken from village life. In 22 CE, before a battle with Wang Mang's general Lian Dan, they painted their eyebrows red so they could tell friend from foe. They won, Lian Dan was killed, and from then on they were known as the Red Eyebrows.
Their numbers grew to several hundred thousand. In 25 CE they took Chang'an and set up a boy of the Liu clan as their own emperor.
story_zh: 公元18年，东部地区水患饥荒蔓延，樊崇在琅琊郡莒县（今属山东）带领一百多人起义。不到一年，追随者就增加到一万多人，其他起义队伍也纷纷加入。
起义军没有什么成文的法令，只约定：杀人者死，伤人者赔偿。首领们的称号也取自乡村生活。公元22年，在与王莽的将领廉丹交战前，他们把眉毛涂成红色，以便分辨敌我。这一仗他们大获全胜，廉丹战死，从此人们称他们为“赤眉军”。
赤眉军发展到几十万人。公元25年，他们攻入长安，拥立一个刘氏少年为帝。
red-eyebrows.why: The Red Eyebrows were the largest peasant army of the age and helped destroy both the Xin and the Gengshi regime.
red-eyebrows.why_zh: 赤眉军是当时规模最大的农民军，先后摧毁了新朝和更始政权。

story: Liu Yan and his younger brother Liu Xiu were distant descendants of Emperor Jing of Han. Their branch of the family had sunk to the level of local landowners at Chongling in Nanyang. Liu Yan was bold and loved to gather followers; Liu Xiu was careful and spent his time farming.

In the tenth month of 22 CE, with famine spreading and the Lülin rebels nearby, the brothers raised troops with their relatives and clients, calling for the restoration of the Han. Liu Xiu at first had no horse and rode into battle on an ox until he captured one.

After an early defeat in which several family members were killed, the brothers joined forces with the Xinshi and Pinglin armies of the Lülin movement. The combined army won a series of victories in Nanyang.
story_zh: 刘縯和弟弟刘秀是汉景帝的远支后裔，到他们这一代，家族已经沦为南阳舂陵的地方地主。刘縯豪爽好客，喜欢结交豪杰；刘秀谨慎稳重，专心务农。
公元22年十月，饥荒蔓延，绿林军又近在咫尺，兄弟二人带领宗族和宾客起兵，打出恢复汉室的旗号。刘秀起初没有马，只好骑着牛上阵，后来才缴获了一匹马。
早期一次战败中，他们的好几位亲人遇难。兄弟俩随后与绿林军的新市兵、平林兵联合，在南阳一带接连取胜。
liu-xiu-rises.why: The rising brought the Han royal name into the rebellion and began Liu Xiu's path to founding the Eastern Han.
liu-xiu-rises.why_zh: 这次起兵把汉室的旗号带进了起义军，也开启了刘秀建立东汉的历程。

story: By early 23 CE the Lülin armies and the Liu brothers controlled much of Nanyang. They needed a leader with a claim to the Han throne. Liu Yan was the obvious choice, but the Lülin commanders feared his strength and preferred a weaker man.

They chose Liu Xuan, another distant member of the Liu family. In the second month of 23 CE he was proclaimed emperor on a sandbank of the Yu River and took the era name Gengshi, meaning 'a fresh start'. He is said to have been so nervous that he sweated and could not speak.

After the victory at Kunyang, the Gengshi Emperor had Liu Yan killed, fearing his popularity. Liu Xiu hid his grief and was later sent north to Hebei, where he built his own power base. The Gengshi regime took Luoyang and Chang'an, but it was overthrown by the Red Eyebrows in 25 CE.
story_zh: 到公元23年初，绿林军和刘氏兄弟已控制了南阳大部分地区，需要推举一位有汉室血统的首领。论威望本应是刘縯，但绿林将领们忌惮他的实力，宁愿选一个更容易驾驭的人。
他们选中了同样是刘氏远支的刘玄。公元23年二月，刘玄在淯水边的沙洲上即皇帝位，改元“更始”，意为重新开始。据说他当时紧张得满头大汗，说不出话来。
昆阳大捷后，更始帝因忌惮刘縯威望太高，将他杀害。刘秀强忍悲痛，后来被派往河北，在那里建立了自己的势力。更始政权先后占领洛阳和长安，但在公元25年被赤眉军推翻。
gengshi.why: The Gengshi Emperor gave the rebellion a Han banner, but his weak rule opened the way for Liu Xiu to found the Eastern Han.
gengshi.why_zh: 更始帝为起义军树起了汉朝的旗帜，但他统治软弱，为刘秀建立东汉让开了道路。

story: After Kunyang, rebel armies closed in on Chang'an from several directions, and people inside the city rose up as well. In the tenth month of 23 CE the rebels broke through the gates and fought their way into the Weiyang Palace, which caught fire.

Wang Mang, dressed in his imperial robes and holding a ritual dagger, fled to the Jiantai, a terrace in the palace lake, with about a thousand followers. Even then he insisted that Heaven had given him virtue and the Han soldiers could do nothing to him. The rebels surrounded the terrace, and when the followers' arrows ran out, they stormed it.
A merchant named Du Wu killed Wang Mang. Soldiers cut his body to pieces, and his head was sent to the Gengshi Emperor at Wan and hung up in the market, where people threw things at it.
story_zh: 昆阳之战后，各路起义军从几个方向逼近长安，城中百姓也起来响应。公元23年十月，起义军攻破城门，一路杀进未央宫，宫中燃起大火。
王莽穿着皇帝的服饰，手持礼仪用的匕首，带着约一千名随从逃到宫中池水里的渐台上。即便到了这个时候，他仍然坚称上天赋予了他美德，汉兵奈何不了他。起义军把渐台团团围住，等台上随从的箭射光了，便冲了上去。
商人杜吴杀死了王莽。士兵们把他的尸体分割，首级被送到宛城的更始帝那里，挂在集市上示众，百姓纷纷向它投掷东西。
wang-mang-death.why: Wang Mang's death ended the Xin dynasty after fifteen years and left the Liu clan to fight over the restored Han.
wang-mang-death.why_zh: 王莽之死结束了仅存十五年的新朝，恢复汉朝的大业留给了刘氏宗室去争夺。

quote.zh: 天生德于予，汉兵其如予何！
quote.en: Heaven gave me my virtue; what can the Han soldiers do to me!
